title: Book Two · Chapter 180: The Window Pot
story:
Mum wants to move the plant by the window. It has grown wider, and one branch now rests against the curtain.

“A larger home,” Dad says.

Ronan looks around the room. “For all of us?”

“For the plant.”

Mum has a larger pot from a friend. She spreads old paper on the yard floor. Dad brings a small bag of earth. Ronan carries the plant with both hands.

The pot is heavier than he expects. He sets it down carefully beside the paper. A few dry leaves fall from the back.

“Those were hiding,” he says.

“Plants have untidy corners too,” Mum answers.

Dad loosens the earth around the old pot. Mum lifts the plant and checks the roots. Ronan holds the new pot still while they put it inside.

Some earth lands on his shoe.

“It wants your foot as well,” Dad says.

“My foot already has a home.”

They add earth around the sides. Mum turns the pot until the widest leaves face the open yard. Ronan brings water in a small jug. He pours too fast at first. Then he slows down.

Mum puts a hand under the lowest leaf. Water runs from the end of the leaf onto her wrist.

“A very small shower,” she says.

Dad offers the towel. She shakes water at him before she takes it. He moves away too late. Ronan laughs and gets a drop on his own cheek.

They leave the plant in the shade for a while. Dad sits on the step and stretches his legs. Mum takes the other end. Ronan brings three cups of water.

For once, no one needs the table. Mum has no customer before evening. Dad has the afternoon free from Mr Sun's work. Ronan's school books can wait another hour.

“We could go to the river,” Mum says.

“Now?” Ronan asks.

“After we clean this.”

They fold the dirty sides of the paper together. Then they clear the yard. Ronan wipes his shoes. Then they walk together, with no bike and no work bag.

At the river, Dad points to a white bird on the far bank. Ronan sees a pale stone instead. They disagree until the bird moves.

“Your stone is leaving,” Mum says.

They stand at the fence and watch it fly low over the water. On the way home, Ronan walks between his parents for part of the road. He takes up more space now. Their shoulders bump at the narrow corner.

At the green door, the plant is still in the shade. Mum touches a leaf, opens the door, and goes inside with Dad and Ronan.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

branch＝枝条；root＝根；earth＝泥土；shade＝阴凉处。

## 理解问题

1. 一家人怎样一起给植物换盆？
2. 这天下午，他们共享了哪些无需证明成绩的快乐？

## 读句子

**He pours too fast at first.**

拆开看：He / pours / too fast at first.

他／起初倒得／太快。
